note: Versions that must not be installed. Reviewed in this repository so the list works offline and cannot be emptied by whoever controls the community index. A remote index may add entries at runtime; it can never remove one. Entries are mirrored from the community index's blocked_versions.json when a block is decided there; a test pins the list non-empty so the offline floor cannot silently regress to nothing (audit S-SUP-18).
